Financial.description: Documents related to finances, banking, investments, and payments.

children.Invoice: Bills and payment requests from vendors or clients.
children.Tax: Tax returns, forms, and related financial documents for government purposes.

Legal.description: Official legal documents, contracts, and agreements.

children.Contract: Formal, signed agreements and legally binding contracts.
children.Agreement: Non-binding agreements, memorandums of understanding, or less formal accords.

Personal.description: Private documents related to an individual's personal life.

children.Identification: Passports, driver's licenses, ID cards, and other identity verification documents.
children.Health: Medical records, insurance documents, lab results, and health-related correspondence.

Travel.description: Documents related to travel planning and execution.

children.Flight: Airline tickets, boarding passes, and flight itineraries.
children.Hotel: Hotel reservation confirmations, booking details, and receipts.

Work.description: Documents related to professional activities, employment, or business projects.

children.Project: Project plans, specifications, reports, and deliverables.
children.Meeting: Meeting agendas, minutes, notes, and presentations.
children.Marketing: Promotional materials, campaigns, market research, and branding documents.

Education.description: Documents related to academic pursuits and achievements.

children.Certificate: Diplomas, awards, certifications, and official recognitions.
children.Transcript: Academic records detailing courses taken and grades received.

children.User Manuals: Instructions, guides, and documentation for products, software, or hardware.
